description:
Create one new listing for this shop: something to sell or rent out, a service, or a job.

Give a category, a title, the price in VND (a job's monthly salary goes in `salaryM`) and the district; text, condition, brand and model are optional. Photos are public image URLs: most categories need 3 of different angles, services 1, jobs none.

It goes live at once unless eno must check it first. It is refused with a reason code, and nothing is created, when photos or the district are missing, the text holds a phone number, the category is unknown, the account may not post, or the same listing is still active (`duplicate_listing`, with its id).

Returns `listing` with the new `id`, `verified` (true when already public), `held` (true while it waits for eno's licence check) and its page `url`. To post many at once, use bulk_create_listings.

brand.description: The brand, matched to eno's brand list even with typos; only used in categories that have brands. Leave it out when the item has none

categorySlug.description: Category slug: vehicles, rentals, property, moving-sale, furniture-appliances, electronics, fashion-beauty, sports, baby-kids, books-stationery, hobbies-sports, pets, jobs, services, community-events, tickets-travel, food-drink (rooms and flats to let: rentals)

condition.description: The item's condition in words (cut at 60 characters), e.g. "new", "like new" or "used"; ignored for a job. Leave it out when it does not apply

description.description: The listing page's text: what it is, its state, what comes with it. No contact details (phone, e-mail, links); cut at 5,000 characters. Leave it out for no text

district.description: The district or area as free text, e.g. "Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức" (cut at 80 characters). A new listing needs it (else `location_required`)

images.description: Photos as public image URLs, in display order; eno copies them and uses the first 8. Most categories need 3 of different angles (else `photos_min`), services 1 (else `photo_required`), jobs none. On a new listing, leave it out only for a job

listingType.description: What the listing offers: "sell" or "rent" where the category allows it ("job" or "wanted" in jobs); otherwise the category's usual one is used

model.description: The model within that brand; kept only when the brand was recognised. Leave it out when unknown

negotiable.description: Whether buyers may send offers below the price (yes unless you say no); services and jobs never take offers

price.description: The asking price in VND. Needed for everything except a job (category "jobs"), whose pay is `salaryM`; a job sent with only a price has it read as the monthly salary.

salaryM.description: A job's monthly salary in millions of VND, as a whole number: 25 means 25.000.000 đ a month (category "jobs"). Leave it out when the pay is agreed with the candidate

title.description: The headline buyers see: the item and what sets it apart, e.g. "Honda Vision 2022, 8,000 km". No phone number; cut at 140 characters

name: create_listing

held.description: true while it waits for eno's licence check, and verified is then false; false otherwise. Tell the seller it goes live if eno approves the licence

id.description: The new listing's id; pass it to update_listing or set_listing_status

url.description: Its page on eno; share it with buyers once the listing is public

verified.description: true when the listing was published at once; false while it waits for eno's check and is not public yet

title: Create marketplace listing
